title: Brock Purdy: Weird not having Kyle Shanahan at practice, but we're handling it

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brock Purdy: Weird not having Kyle Shanahan at practice, but we're handling it
sources.description: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan has observed portions of the team's early training camp practices, but he has not been running them as he continues to recover from injuries he suffered in a car accident earlier this month.
